snippet.title: Fading Echo | PC Launch Date Trailer
snippet.description:
*Fading Echo launches on PC on July 21!*

🎮 *Demo Available now!* https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/

Fading Echo is a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG set in the scorched, floating isles and shattered dimensions of Corel.
Play as One, a young Legend with a tangled past and very little time left to fix it. Paradox Corruption is spreading and your home is slowly vanishing... Armed with Ætheric powers and the ability to turn water into destruction, you’ll slide, shift, and smash your way through surreal realities to stop the decay of your world.

Bringing the world to life with an incredible cast: Samantha Béart, Jasmine Bhullar, Laura Bailey, Liam O’Brien, Sam Riegel and Matt Mercer.

Console releases are planned for later this year.

💬 *Join the Echoverse on Discord :* https://discord.gg/fadingechogame

🌊 *Follow the Adventure*
YouTube: http://www.youtube.com/@FadingEchoGame?sub_confirmation=1
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@fadingechogame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fadingechogame/
Website: https://www.fading-echo.com

#FadingEcho #Gaming  #indiegames #RPG #Adventure
